summary: Amass Brands filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to register the resale of up to 14,293,298 common shares by existing stockholders in connection with a direct listing on Nasdaq. The supplement also discloses an amendment to a warrant held by Streeterville Capital, temporarily reducing the exercise price to $3.00 per share for a 90-day period (otherwise $16.00), with the company able to terminate early. This is a routine shelf takedown and warrant modification, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or strategic review is present.
